name: Free
tagline: The core collection. Free and open source.
intro: Envelopes, sequencers, clocks, macro controllers, oscillators, physical models, mixers and effects. Each one turns simple inputs into a wide spread of modulation and sound, and they're built to be patched into each other.

name: Modulations

videos.title: CV funk Modulations overview and tutorial

tagline: Polyphonic modulation, built around a complex oscillator.
intro: SYZYGY, a complex oscillator grown from OUROS, with a fully polyphonic sequencer (ARRANGE XL), envelope generator (ENVELOPE CITY) and LFO (SUPER WONK), all with a streamlined workflow.

name: Chord Caster
tagline: A complete poly synth and composition tool in one module.
intro: CHORD CASTER sequences chords, voicings and rhythms bar by bar through a six-voice oscillator, modulation bus, mixer and delay. Every step can recall all 42 knobs and 20 button states. POLY MAP and CHORDY extend it.

name: Sands

videos.title: Exploring CV funk Sands: 5 generative patches

tagline: Add a non-linear dimension to your patches.
intro: The 2026 collection: physical models (DROPLET, STRANDS), a living ecosystem (SIROCCO), morphing oscillators (ZEPHYR, DRIFTS), probabilistic routing (ARCS), displaced rhythms (CROSSWINDS, DUNES) and a chord-aware quantizer (MIRAGE).
